posts.text:
BREAKING: SpaceX says Boca Chica Beach will remain public, outlining major efforts to protect and restore it.

• More than 50 tons of trash have been removed through weekly beach cleanups with the City of Starbase.

• It has offered to invest tens of millions of dollars to fight beach erosion, restore the shoreline and preserve public access.

• Its work with conservation partners has contributed to record sea turtle rescue efforts.

• The proposed purchase covers approximately 1,200 acres surrounding the launch facility. Boca Chica Beach and the Texas coastline are excluded.

• Around 600 acres would be permanently protected from development to preserve sensitive coastal habitat.

• Proceeds from the proposed sale would help Texas invest in new parks and recreation in the Rio Grande Valley.

• SpaceX is working with state agencies to improve safety around the launch facility while maintaining public beach access.

BREAKING: Zambia’s government has begun deploying 751 @Starlink kits to health facilities across all 10 provinces. 🇿🇲

• 90 kits already delivered to Western Province’s Provincial Health Office.
• Targeting underserved and hard-to-reach communities.
• Supporting digital health services and better communication between facilities.
• Funded by the Global Fund through the Ministry of Health, with UNDP support.

Starlink is helping bring better connectivity where it matters most: healthcare.

BREAKING: Starlink is bringing fast internet to rural communities in Timor-Leste. 🇹🇱

In Suco Aubeon, residents and community leaders now have @Starlink through VorakaiConnect, helping:

• Families stay connected.
• Residents access news and information.
• Community leaders carry out local administration.

Across the country, the Government’s partnership with Vorakai covers 450 village headquarters, using Starlink to connect local offices to digital government systems while fiber networks expand.
